name: Notify CRM
author: Notify CRM Team

sections.description:
Notify CRM is a free WooCommerce plugin for sending order status updates to customers via WhatsApp. It also adds custom order statuses, branded transactional emails, courier shipment tracking, and a floating WhatsApp chat button to your WooCommerce store.

Unlike WhatsApp Business API plugins that charge per message and require Meta Business verification, Notify CRM uses wa.me links — no API keys, no per-message fees, no complicated setup. Works with your regular WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business app.

WhatsApp Order Notifications for WooCommerce

When a WooCommerce order status changes (e.g., Processing → Shipped), Notify CRM queues a WhatsApp message with all the order details. You review pending messages in your WordPress admin dashboard, then send them with one click. Customers receive a formatted WhatsApp message with order ID, items, totals, and tracking information.

Track Your Order page

Add the shortcode [notifycrm_track_order] to any page. Customers enter their order number and the email or phone number they used at checkout and see their courier, tracking number and order status, with a tracking link when one is available. Lookups need both values, so nobody can view someone else’s order by guessing a number.

Custom WooCommerce Order Statuses

Go beyond WooCommerce’s built-in statuses. Create custom order statuses to match your real fulfillment workflow:

  • New Order — freshly placed orders awaiting confirmation
  • Pending Confirmation — orders waiting for payment or stock verification
  • Shipped — orders dispatched with courier and tracking info
  • Out for Delivery — orders with the delivery agent
  • Delivered — successfully completed orders
  • Returned / RTO — returned or refused shipments
  • Cancelled — cancelled orders

Each custom status gets its own color for easy identification in the WooCommerce orders list. Map WhatsApp message templates and branded email templates to each status change.

Branded WooCommerce Email Templates

Replace WooCommerce’s default plain emails with professional, branded HTML email templates. Customize the subject line, heading, and email body for every order status. Add your store logo, brand colors, and personalized messaging to every customer communication.

Courier Tracking & Shipment Management

Pick couriers from the shared courier library or add your own — local, national, or regional — with custom tracking URL templates. When you add a tracking number to WooCommerce order notes, Notify CRM auto-detects it and includes the tracking link in WhatsApp messages and branded emails.

This is especially useful for stores using local couriers or shipping providers that WooCommerce doesn’t natively support for tracking.

Floating WhatsApp Chat Button for WooCommerce

Add a customizable WhatsApp contact button to your WooCommerce storefront. Customers can reach you directly via WhatsApp from any page on your store. Customize the button position (bottom-left or bottom-right), color to match your brand, and greeting message.

All Key Features

  • WhatsApp Message Queue — Messages are queued automatically when WooCommerce order status changes. Send them manually via wa.me with one click.
  • Bulk WhatsApp Actions — Select multiple WooCommerce orders and send WhatsApp updates in bulk from the orders list.
  • Phone Number Normalization — Automatically formats customer phone numbers to international format with country code support for reliable WhatsApp delivery.
  • Admin Bar Notifications — See pending WhatsApp message count at a glance in the WordPress admin bar.
  • Order Screen WhatsApp Actions — Send WhatsApp messages directly from the WooCommerce order edit screen with pre-filled message templates.
  • Message Log — Track all sent WhatsApp messages with status, date, and delivery method in a searchable log.
  • Custom Message Templates — Use variables like {name}, {order_id}, {items}, {total}, {courier}, and {tracking_number} to personalize WhatsApp messages for each order status.

Free, with an optional paid add-on

Notify CRM is fully functional on its own and stays free. Nothing in this plugin is locked or time-limited. Stores that want automatic WhatsApp Cloud API sending, a shared inbox, abandoned-cart recovery, COD confirmation and other advanced tools can install Notify CRM Pro, a separate optional plugin distributed from our website. Notify CRM Pro contains everything in this plugin and replaces it; if both are active, this free plugin pauses itself automatically and your settings are kept.

Who Should Use Notify CRM?

Notify CRM is built for WooCommerce store owners who:

  • Want to send WooCommerce order updates via WhatsApp without paying for the WhatsApp Business API
  • Need custom WooCommerce order statuses to match their real order fulfillment workflow
  • Want to send branded, professional WooCommerce transactional emails instead of default templates
  • Ship with local or regional couriers that WooCommerce doesn’t natively support for tracking
  • Want a WhatsApp chat button on their WooCommerce store for customer support
  • Run a small to medium WooCommerce store and need an all-in-one order communication tool

How Notify CRM Works

  1. Install and activate Notify CRM from the WordPress plugin directory
  2. Register your WooCommerce store in the Store tab
  3. Create and customize your order statuses in the Statuses tab
  4. Set up WhatsApp message templates in the Order Statuses tab
  5. When a WooCommerce order status changes, Notify CRM queues the WhatsApp notification
  6. Click “Send WhatsApp” — the plugin opens wa.me with the pre-filled message. Just press send.
  7. Branded transactional emails are sent automatically for each order status change

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.2+
  • Works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes
  • Compatible with major WooCommerce order management workflows

External Services

This plugin connects to the Notify CRM server, operated by the plugin author, to provide store registration and account management. Nothing is sent until you register your store or log in from the Store tab.

Service: Notify CRM
URL: https://api.hustletoevolve.com
Terms of Service: https://api.hustletoevolve.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://api.hustletoevolve.com/privacy

Endpoints used and when data is sent:

  1. Registration status (/api/plugin/status, /api/customer/verify) — Checks your registration status (the result is cached). Sends: store key, store URL.
  2. Register (/api/plugin/register, /api/customer/register, /api/customer/store-data) — When you register your store or save your store details in the Store tab. Sends: store URL, store name, owner name, owner email, WhatsApp number, plugin / WordPress / WooCommerce / PHP versions, store key, and the address of your site’s COD-reply REST endpoint. If you create a Notify CRM account, also the email and password you choose.
  3. Log in (/api/customer/login) — When you log in to an existing Notify CRM account from the Store tab. Sends: the email and password you enter, store URL. The password is sent over HTTPS and is not stored by this plugin.
  4. Find store (/api/customer/find-store) — Looks up an existing registration by domain. Sends: store domain.
  5. Send counter (/api/customer/log-manual) — Each time you click “Send WhatsApp”. Sends: store key and WooCommerce order number only. The customer’s name, phone number and the message text are NOT sent; they stay on your site.
  6. Disconnect (/api/customer/disconnect) — When you manually disconnect your store. Sends: store key.
  7. Delete (/api/plugin/delete, /api/customer/delete-account) — When you delete your account. Sends: store key, store URL.
  8. Plan status (/api/plugin/plan/status) — For a registered store, while you are on a Notify CRM screen (at most every few hours) or when you click “Refresh Plan”. Sends: store key, store URL. Returns your current plan and the current checkout price IDs, which are shown on the Account tab. Nothing in this free plugin is locked by it.
  9. Courier library (/api/plugin/courier/library) — When you search the courier library on the Couriers tab. Sends: store key and the text you typed in the search box. Returns a list of couriers (name, region and, where available, a tracking link template).

Purpose: Store registration and account management. The data is used solely for plugin operation and to notify you about updates or new features.

No payment data, customer data, customer phone numbers or message contents are ever transmitted to the Notify CRM server. Messages themselves are sent by you through WhatsApp (wa.me); they do not pass through the Notify CRM server.

Links inside the plugin (for example “View All Plans & Compare” or “Download Notify CRM Pro”) open our website only when you click them. For a registered store, the plans link includes your store key, current plan, WordPress admin email and checkout price IDs in the address, so the pricing page can show your plan and start checkout. Nothing is opened or sent until you click.

Privacy Policy

Notify CRM collects store registration data (store name, URL, owner name, email, WhatsApp number, and software version information) and sends it to the Notify CRM server (api.hustletoevolve.com) when you register your store. When you click “Send WhatsApp” it also sends a send counter (store key and WooCommerce order number). If you log in to a Notify CRM account, the email and password you enter are sent to the same server over HTTPS.

No customer names, phone numbers, email addresses, shipping addresses, message text or payment information is ever sent to any external server.

To delete your data from the server, go to Notify CRM > Account tab and click “Delete Account” in the Danger Zone.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the notify-crm folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly by searching “Notify CRM” in the WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Notify CRM in the WordPress admin menu to configure your settings
  4. Go to the Store tab and complete your store registration (store name, email, WhatsApp number)
  5. Customize your WooCommerce order statuses in the Statuses tab
  6. Configure WhatsApp message templates in the Order Statuses tab
  7. Add your courier services in the Couriers tab (optional)
  8. Enable the floating WhatsApp button in the Widget tab (optional)
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send WhatsApp messages automatically?

No. Notify CRM queues WhatsApp messages when WooCommerce order status changes. You send them manually by clicking the “Send WhatsApp” button, which opens wa.me with the pre-filled message. You just press send. This keeps you in full control of every customer message.

Do I need a WhatsApp Business API account?

No. Notify CRM uses wa.me links to open WhatsApp Web or the WhatsApp app on your phone. No API account, no Meta Business verification, no per-message fees. Works with your regular WhatsApp number.

Is Notify CRM free?

Yes. Everything in this plugin is free to install and use, with no locked features and no trial period. An optional, separate paid plugin (Notify CRM Pro) is available from our website for stores that want advanced features such as automatic WhatsApp Cloud API sending. It is never required.

I used version 1.2.0 with paid features. Where did they go?

Version 1.2.0 combined the free and paid features in one plugin. From version 1.3.0 this plugin contains the free features only, and the paid features are in the separate Notify CRM Pro plugin. If you only used the free features, nothing changes for you. If you were on a paid plan, install Notify CRM Pro (see your plan page on our website) to keep using them. Your settings and data are kept.

Can I run Notify CRM and Notify CRM Pro together?

You do not need to. Notify CRM Pro includes everything in this plugin. If both are active, this free plugin pauses itself automatically, and you can then deactivate and delete it safely. Deleting it does not remove your settings while Notify CRM Pro is installed.

Will this work with my WooCommerce theme?

Yes. Notify CRM hooks into WooCommerce’s order system and doesn’t modify your theme templates. It works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Can I customize the WhatsApp message templates?

Yes. Go to Notify CRM > Order Statuses tab to customize WhatsApp messages for each WooCommerce order status. You can use variables like {name}, {order_id}, {items}, {total}, {courier}, and {tracking_number} to auto-fill order details in every message.

Does it support multiple courier services?

Yes. You can add as many courier services as you need in Notify CRM, each with its own tracking URL template. The plugin auto-detects tracking numbers from WooCommerce order notes and includes the tracking link in WhatsApp messages and emails.

Does this plugin collect or send my WooCommerce customer data to external servers?

No customer data is sent. Notify CRM never sends customer names, phone numbers, email addresses, shipping addresses, message text or payment information to any external server. The only information sent to the Notify CRM server is your store registration details (store name, URL, owner name, owner email, WhatsApp number, software versions), and, each time you click “Send WhatsApp”, a send counter consisting of your store key and the WooCommerce order number. See the External Services section below for full details.

Will Notify CRM slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Notify CRM only loads its admin scripts on its own settings pages and WooCommerce order screens. Nothing loads on the storefront except the optional floating WhatsApp button.

Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages for multiple WooCommerce orders?

Yes. From the WooCommerce orders list, select multiple orders and use the bulk action to queue WhatsApp messages for all of them at once.

Can I track WhatsApp message delivery?

Notify CRM logs all sent messages with status, date, and delivery method in the Message Log. Since messages are sent via wa.me, delivery confirmation happens through WhatsApp itself.

Does Notify CRM work with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Notify CRM fully supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and cart/checkout blocks. It declares compatibility with both custom_order_tables and cart_checkout_blocks.

Can I add my own custom courier services?

Yes. Notify CRM lets you add any courier service with a custom tracking URL template. This is ideal for local and regional couriers that aren’t supported by WooCommerce’s built-in shipping integrations.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • New: the Account tab shows your current plan, a “Refresh Plan” button and a “View All Plans & Compare” button; plan links now carry your store details so the pricing page recognises your store and opens checkout.
  • New: stores that have paid get a “Download Notify CRM Pro” button and notice.
  • New: Engagement, WhatsApp Shop, Team Hub, Store and Couriers tabs now show what Notify CRM Pro adds, with example previews and plan labels. They are information only and open the pricing page.
  • New: order statuses New Order, Shipped, Returned and Payment Received are built in, as in Notify CRM Pro, so every status can have its own WhatsApp and email message.
  • Fixed: a custom order status set to send automatically sent each message twice. Each status now sends once.
  • Fixed: the text shown in the Order Statuses tab for an unedited status is now exactly what is sent.
  • New: [notifycrm_track_order] shortcode – a ready-made “Track Your Order” form (order number + email or phone) for any page.
  • New: refreshed admin design shared with Notify CRM Pro – new header, menu icon, compact cards, merged Notifications into the Order Statuses tab (WhatsApp and email messages per status).
  • New: Couriers tab redesigned like Notify CRM Pro, with a courier library (search and add couriers), auto-detection of tracking numbers saved by other shipping plugins (AWB, consignment, CN and similar), and tracking links built from each courier’s template.
  • Fixed: tracking-link templates lost their {tracking_number} placeholder when saved, so courier links did not point at the shipment. New saves keep it, and links saved by earlier versions are repaired automatically.
  • Fixed: message text and on/off switches edited in the Order Statuses tab are now used when WhatsApp messages and emails are sent (previously the saved templates were not applied to outgoing messages).
  • Improved: Store tab – email sender fields now sit with Store Details; floating chat button gets a chat panel and quick replies.
  • Improved: Engagement tab now lists what the Pro plugin adds.
  • Improved: store key is masked with Show / Copy buttons.

1.3.0

  • Notify CRM is the free edition again: paid-plan features now live in the separate Notify CRM Pro plugin
  • The plugin pauses itself automatically when Notify CRM Pro is active; no conflicts, settings kept
  • Privacy: clicking “Send WhatsApp” no longer sends the customer’s phone number or message text to the Notify CRM server (only a send counter)
  • The Message Queue always sends through wa.me; removed an unused server-send path
  • Removed unused WhatsApp-session code
  • Safer upgrades and uninstall: the database version no longer moves backwards, and deleting this plugin leaves your data alone when Notify CRM Pro is installed
  • External Services section rewritten to list exactly what the plugin sends
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1

1.2.0

  • Combined the free and paid features in a single plugin (replaced in 1.3.0 by the separate Notify CRM Pro plugin)

1.0.0

  • Initial release — free WooCommerce WhatsApp order notifications
  • WhatsApp message queue with one-click wa.me sending for WooCommerce orders
  • Custom WooCommerce order statuses (New Order, Pending Confirmation, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Returned / RTO, Cancelled)
  • Bulk WhatsApp send from WooCommerce orders list
  • Branded HTML email templates for WooCommerce transactional emails
  • Courier management with tracking URL templates and auto-detection from order notes
  • Floating WhatsApp chat button for WooCommerce storefront
  • Phone number normalization with international country code support
  • WordPress admin bar notification badge for pending WhatsApp messages
  • WooCommerce order edit screen WhatsApp actions with pre-filled templates
  • Full WhatsApp message log with search and delivery history
